## What changed

Describe the evidence workflow, implementation, and user-facing behavior.

## Why

Explain the concrete research or integrity failure mode.

## Durable artifacts

- [ ] No schema changes
- [ ] Schema changes are documented and versioned
- [ ] Migration or compatibility behavior is documented

## Validation

- [ ] Unit and integration tests
- [ ] Tamper or malformed-input test where relevant
- [ ] Deterministic demo check
- [ ] Repository audit
- [ ] No private or proprietary laboratory data

## Claim boundary

State what the change can establish and what it still cannot establish.
